written: 2026-10-15, before arms B and C were written and before real request set 3 was collected. Assistant-authored from general category knowledge and the categories seen in spent development sets (Phase248 dev and held-out 1-2, Phase249 real sets 1-2). It is the shared label space for gold and for every arm: an arm may instantiate any subset of it. Not independently adjudicated.
rules: A need is something the user wants the product to do, suit or avoid (an outcome, task, environment, constraint or failure to avoid), stated or clearly implied by the request. Price limits are scored separately as budget.
A need not in this catalogue is recorded in gold as unlisted, with a short description; it counts in the all-needs recall denominator.
Category ids name the product the user is choosing; other:<name> for products outside the list; null when no product purchase is being decided.

generic_needs.small_kitchen: limited counter, cupboard or room space
generic_needs.cleaning_effort: easy to clean, few parts, dishwasher-safe
generic_needs.low_maintenance: little routine upkeep (descaling, servicing, part replacement)
generic_needs.ease_of_use: simple operation, little effort or skill, automation
generic_needs.durability: lasts long, robust, reliable over years
generic_needs.occasional_use: used rarely, so simplicity, storage or low cost matter more than performance
generic_needs.batch_capacity: enough capacity for the number of people or the quantity made at once
generic_needs.portability: easy to move, travel or camping use
